events.title: Sirius Is Coming to Your Desktop for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We're O.Z.D.K, and this is our first announcement here on Steam. A huge thank you to everyone who's been following the game! Since our store page went live in June, we've been refining the game. We're excited to announce that our demo will launch during Steam Next Fest this October!
